defective_pattern: Omitting w:hint="cs" and w:eastAsia in OpenXML w:rFonts for Persian text, failing to wrap Latin acronyms in specific LTR font configurations, and using non-localized numerals.
why_defective: Causes Word to fallback to Arabic Naskh rendering for Persian text, disrupting visual consistency. Fails to visually isolate Latin characters and uses unstandardized Western numerals in Persian text.
observed_symptoms: Persian text rendering in Arabic Naskh font in Word instead of the intended Persian font
Latin acronyms (IUS-12, SCI-16) not isolated in Times New Roman
Latin numerals (18.0) used instead of Persian numerals (۱۸.۰)
Presence of AI clichés like 'در این راستا' in generated markdown
corrective_remedy: 1) Inject w:hint="cs" and w:eastAsia="{font_name}" into w:rFonts in python-docx compiler. 2) Wrap Latin acronyms and statistics in Times New Roman. 3) Sanitize markdown prompt against robotic phrases. 4) Convert non-code numbers to Persian localized digits with leading zeros.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Missing w:hint="cs" in OpenXML generation scripts or presence of AI clichés in Persian text
